tasks.label: Inspect BuildKart drive and Git state
args: const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');const src='C:/Users/NIKHIL DHOOPAL/OneDrive/Desktop/BuildKart-Material';try{const s=fs.statfsSync('D:/');console.log('D_DRIVE',JSON.stringify({freeBytes:s.bavail*s.bsize,totalBytes:s.blocks*s.bsize}))}catch(e){console.log('D_DRIVE_ERROR',e.message)}let total=0,files=0;function walk(d){for(const x of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const f=p.join(d,x.name);if(x.isDirectory())walk(f);else{try{total+=fs.statSync(f).size;files++}catch(e){}}}}walk(src);console.log('SOURCE_SIZE',JSON.stringify({files,totalBytes:total}));for(const [label,args] of [['STATUS',['-C',src,'status','--short','--branch']],['REMOTE',['-C',src,'remote','-v']]]){const r=cp.spawnSync('git',args,{encoding:'utf8'});console.log(label,JSON.stringify({code:r.status,stdout:r.stdout,stderr:r.stderr}))}const lock=p.join(src,'.git','index.lock');console.log('INDEX_LOCK',fs.existsSync(lock));const task=cp.spawnSync('tasklist',['/FI','IMAGENAME eq git.exe'],{encoding:'utf8'});console.log('GIT_PROCESSES',task.stdout);
